title: Signing Off and Appreciations
content: It never occurred to me in 1994 when I submitted by first article to Don Grimes, the founding editor of Microscopy Today, that I would continue to contribute to every single issue for almost three decades! Since then, I have had the privilege and pleasure of working with all the Editors-in-Chief: Ron Anderson, Charlie Lyman, and Bob Price. I have Charlie Lyman to thank for naming “Carmichael’s Concise Review.” In addition, working with the production manager, Gennifer Levey, has been a pleasure. She does the layout on my reviews, and I know it is a challenge for her to work with short articles, but she understands that “concise” is part of my package. But my deepest appreciation goes to the person who edited the first drafts of all those articles, my wife, Dr. Susan Stoddard. I have enlisted the help of a close friend, Dr. Jennifer Younger, who has also edited the last few reviews.
